name: singapore-court-legal
description: Deterministic, proof-carrying resolver for Singapore civil court procedure (Rules of Court 2021) via the MikeROS connector — determines which ROC rule controls, the required sequence, and whether a step is compliant, with a proof or honest abstention (abstain-to-source where control passes to an uncompiled Practice Direction or Form). Cites governing rules with operator-verified case authorities where they attach; never fabricates a rule, sequence, or citation. Use to resolve a procedural position — not for interpretation, drafting, or strategy. Not legal advice.
